title: Concept: R package dependency declared without a version
description: DESCRIPTION declares a `Depends` entry with no version constraint, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: R installs the newest matching package from the configured repositories, so the analysis can change without a DESCRIPTION edit.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through DESCRIPTION (cran).
risk: R installs the newest matching package from the configured repositories, so the analysis can change without a DESCRIPTION edit.
